name: KitchenConversationsMealPlanning

custom.system_prompt: You are generating a kitchen conversation between a couple planning their meals for the upcoming week. They discuss preferences, check what's in the fridge, and occasionally ask their home assistant for recipe ideas or nutritional information.

sound_effects_config.prompt: Quiet kitchen evening, fridge opening, light background hum, papers shuffling

initial_prompt: Generate a relaxed kitchen conversation between two partners planning their meals for the week. They negotiate preferences, take stock of what's available, and consult the assistant for a recipe idea or ingredient suggestion.

variations.context: Sunday evening meal planning for the week

setting.mood: Relaxed and domestic, slightly low-energy after the weekend
setting.relationship_dynamic: Couple who share cooking responsibilities and have different dietary preferences
setting.background: They try to plan ahead to avoid the weeknight stress of not knowing what to cook
setting.conversation_style: Collaborative negotiation with some gentle pushback on suggestions; they know each other's habits well

scenario_template.topic: Acknowledging they need to plan meals and opening the week's calendar
scenario_template.note: They might open the fridge, look at what's left, or one of them raises it casually.

scenario_template.topic: Checking what's in the fridge and pantry, what needs using up
scenario_template.note: Natural fridge-door conversation. Short observations: 'the peppers won't last', 'we still have pasta', etc.

scenario_template.topic: Discussing what they feel like eating, any constraints or cravings
scenario_template.mood: Playful negotiation with some mild disagreement
scenario_template.note: One might want comfort food, the other something lighter. No big conflict — just normal preference management.

scenario_template.topic: Asking Sigma for a recipe idea based on available ingredients or a cuisine they're considering
scenario_template.note: User must address Sigma by name. The question should feel natural — 'Sigma, what can we make with chickpeas and leftover spinach?'

scenario_template.topic: Using the assistant's suggestions to fill out the weekly plan
scenario_template.note: They may ask one follow-up, then agree on a plan between themselves. Assistant steps back.

scenario_template.topic: Finalising the plan and noting what to buy
scenario_template.note: Brief wrap-up — maybe someone takes note on the phone or just verbally confirms the plan.

user1.name: Tobias
user1.role: Practical planner who prefers simple, reliable recipes. Tends to default to what he knows works but is open to trying new things if pushed.

user2.name: Petra
user2.role: More adventurous eater who pushes for variety. Has stronger opinions about flavour and likes experimenting. Sometimes overly optimistic about what they'll have time to cook.

assistant.name: Sigma
assistant.role: Home assistant that provides recipe ideas, ingredient substitution suggestions, and basic nutritional information when asked. Responds only when addressed directly. Keeps suggestions concrete and practical.
